name: Saint Anthony Cathedral Basilica
history: Priests on horseback served Beaumont's settlers from 1853. The first parish, St. Louis Church, was founded in 1879. The present brick church was dedicated in January 1907, became a cathedral when the Diocese of Beaumont was formed in 1966, and was named a basilica by Benedict XVI on 11 July 2006.
arch: A red-brick Romanesque Revival church with twin towers and a copper dome.
features: A restoration renewed the copper dome and added a 2,500-pipe Wicks organ.
Bishop Curtis Guillory re-dedicated and consecrated it in 2004.

look.d: The dome was restored in a major renewal of the cathedral.
Brick towers frame a church built in 1907 for a Gulf Coast port town.

fun: Beaumont's Catholics were first served by circuit-riding priests on horseback.
journal: Gulf Coast brick, a copper dome, and a parish that began with priests on horseback.
